notes.title: 🛠️ ALPHA Demo - Patch 00.00.02 is live!
notes.content: [p]Thanks to your feedback, we’ve made the first improvements to the TYRIUM ALPHA Demo:[/p][p][/p][p]✅ Order icons now include a simple confirmation animation[/p][p]✅ Control layout in the game menu is now displayed correctly[/p][p]✅ Building UI no longer shows the number of assigned builder bots[/p][p]✅ Global sound volume setting added[/p][p]✅ Rockets without a target no longer fly in circles (mostly 😉)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//43806042/3526f34839501662944af666191be812be666686.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//43806042/a617066d15d4a130ba7406ed43319b2574f288f1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning — more updates and improvements are on the way![/p][p][/p][p]💬 Keep the feedback coming: [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2329940/discussions/0/563626489222817911/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2329940/discussions/0/563626489222817911/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]– Chris[/p]
